rotation.rot: Radians. The rotation applied to the canonical target shape to overlay it on the board. One of 0, pi/2, pi, -pi/2.
rotation.reflect: MATCHER flag (NOT the half-set completion mirror). Whether aligning the canonical shape to THIS board needed a mirror. Empirically ~86% of recognized states use reflect=false; only some formations (e.g. Quarter Tag, Tidal Line RH, Two-Faced Lines) ever need reflect=true. Do not conflate with the 180-degree-about-origin mirror that builds a full 8-dancer formation from a 4-dancer half-set at build time (that one is always applied and is NOT stored here).
rotation.cSrc: Centroid of the SOURCE board. In this auto-generated graph every board is origin-centered, so cSrc == (0,0) always. Only a board translated off-origin (e.g. an editor board) yields non-zero.
rotation.cTgt: Centroid of the canonical 8-dancer target formation. Always (0,0) because recognized formations are completed to a full 8-dancer set centered at the origin. cSrc/cTgt are computed BEFORE rot/reflect are applied, so reflection never makes them non-zero.

getoutVsModule.module: Generic call sequence: may start at any formation and end at any formation. No home restriction.
getoutVsModule.getout: A SPECIAL kind of module: always ENDS at home (home.name) and can never START at home. Invariant: kind=='getout'  =>  end.formation == home.name  AND  start.formation != home.name.
getoutVsModule.note: The legacy top-level 'getout' object is a per-formation list of first-step calls (reverse-search result), distinct from modules. A future schema may drop it and express all getouts purely as kind:'getout' modules.
